- Assess and monitor biodiversity across species and habitats — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Assess species habitat requirements and habitat condition — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Recognize and assess ecosystems that have crossed into novel states — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Plan for ecological transformation with resist, accept or direct strategies — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
- Analyze environmental data statistically and interpret the results — journey L2, senior L3, lead L4
